title: Noon sakinah and tanween: the four rules in surahs we know: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Ash-Sharh, Ad-Duha 1 to 8 and applying the rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 33 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Noon sakinah and tanween rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 33. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Look one letter ahead
points: Izhar: clear, before the throat letters ء ه ع ح غ خ
Idgham: merged, before ي ر م ل و ن
Iqlab: changed to meem, before ب
Ikhfa': hidden, before the other 15 letters

blocks.title: Sort into: Izhar / Idgham / Iqlab / Ikhfa'
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Izhar, Idgham, Iqlab, Ikhfa'.
blocks.answer: Izhar: ع; ه. Idgham: ي; ل. Iqlab: ب. Ikhfa': ك

keywords.def: changing the noon into a meem
hiding the noon with a light hum before certain letters

questions.q: Say the rule: «مِنۢ بَعْدِ» (noon before ب).
Pupil PDF: write the rule for eight noon sakinah and tanween words from Juz' 'Amma. Today's rota group recites Ash-Sharh 1 to 6.
questions.a: Each word labelled izhar, idgham, iqlab or ikhfa' correctly.

questions.q: Extend: find the iqlab in Al-Humazah.
Stretch: why does idgham into ل have no ghunnah?
questions.a: ل and ر are the two idgham letters without ghunnah.

questions.q: Noon sakinah before ب is read with ...
questions.a: A) iqlab. Iqlab: the noon turns into a meem with ghunnah.

questions.q: Think again: A noon sakinah can be clear, merged, changed or hidden. What decides which one?
questions.a: The letter that comes next: we always look one letter ahead.
